source_text: Spiritus Domini induit Gedeon; tuba cecinit; vocavit Abiezer. Virtus Dei vocat etiam qui nusquam erant. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Spirit of-Lord clothed Gideon; trumpet sounded; he-called Abiezer. Power of-God calls even who nowhere were. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[The Lord’s Spirit clothed Gideon; he sounded the trumpet and called Abiezer >> Bible:Judges 6:34-35]]. God’s power calls even those who “were nowhere.” Amen.
